allowed: Call the aggregator API from applications and agents using models and routes available to your account.
Use outputs under the applicable upstream Model Terms, including their licensing, regional, and data-use conditions.
forbidden: Do not bypass identity, access, or usage controls, resell API access contrary to the terms, or build a competing aggregator.
Do not reverse engineer OpenRouter; upstream model restrictions depend on their own Model Terms.
Do not assume one route's retention or training policy covers all providers, free models, or optional logging features.
retention: Both OpenRouter and upstream policies matter. Optional prompt logging, private storage, batch processing, and uploaded files can store content; uploaded files persist until deletion/account closure, subject to stated exceptions. Review account and organization data settings.
training: OpenRouter states it does not train models on inputs or outputs. Upstream providers may do so depending on the route and settings; opting into prompt logging grants additional content-use rights, including anonymized data sharing/sale under the terms.
